sentences: People with impaired kidneys do need to be more cautious with large, rapid magnesium doses because they may not clear magnesium normally.
But they should be far more worried about the MDMA.
MDMA can cause overheating, rhabdomyolysis, dangerous electrolyte shifts, and acute kidney injury.
Kidney impairment is a strong reason not to take MDMA--not a reason to sit there with worsening jaw tension after taking it.
I would not tell somebody with serious kidney impairment to copy my one-gram-per-minute approach blindly; I would tell them to treat the situation as higher-risk and get help sooner.
